value.signature: fn dispatch < 'r > (reg : & 'r Registry , env : & Envelope) -> Instrument < 'r >

review.body: { let version = env . version () ; let (major , minor) = (version . major () , version . minor ()) ; let Some (holding) = reg . holding (env . label () , major) else { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; return Instrument :: Refused (RejectionCause :: UnheldMajor) ; } ; if let Some (theory) = holding . theory (minor) { return Instrument :: Strict { minor , theory } ; } if minor <= holding . ceiling { tracing :: event ! (tracing :: Level :: TRACE , outcome = "refusal") ; return Instrument :: Refused (RejectionCause :: UnassignedStamp { ceiling : holding . ceiling , }) ; } Instrument :: Tolerant { floor : holding . ceiling , companion : holding . companion , } }
review.item_premise: The boundary preserves its input, return and refusal predicates. Explicit bounded contract outcomes precede return inference; capture still follows the configured level. This body inherits the public-interchange decision for accept::dispatch.
